_note: Real firm data that is NEVER tracked (ruling 2026-11-10). Every path here is gitignored and local-only. A committed synthetic stand-in lives at fixtures/synthetic/<same path>; scripts/ensure-local-data.ts copies it into place only when the runtime file is absent. Read by scripts/ensure-local-data.ts, scripts/fixtures/build-synthetic-data.ts, scripts/prepush-confidential-scan.mjs and scripts/governance-check.ts. 'files' are exact repo-relative paths; 'dirs' match every file beneath them. 'optional' files may be absent on a checkout that holds real data (they are seeded only on an all-synthetic checkout and are never deploy inputs): the value locks, ratified with `npm run golden:ratify`, and local operator tables. 'neverTrack' lists real-data paths with NO synthetic stand-in and every byte-copy or derived output of real data (the P&L audit CSV and its _out/ build copies, dist/ and the baked public snapshot, macro and warehouse outputs, the overlay, alert state and inbox, the outbox, backups, AR working dirs, the document index, the warehouse, raw lease-market exports, and every local operator file under config/local/; the whole data/ tree, where nothing is tracked, so every quarantine, temp and backup copy a writer leaves there is covered). The checkers also treat a copy of any listed file as real data (copy rule, refute round 7): at any depth under the listed file's folder, or under a copy of that folder, a name that starts with the listed stem followed by the end of the name or a separator (space, '-', '_', '(', '.', '~'), as in Explorer, browser, editor and writer copies; or a name that carries the stem after a declared copy marker (corrupt, tmp, temp, bak, backup, orig, old, quarantine, copy) on a name-segment boundary, as in 'Copy of <name>'. Copies are never seeded and are read only by the push-time scan and the governance check, which block them exactly like the paths above. 'copyRuleAllow' maps a tracked file that shares a listed stem but is not a copy of it to the reason it is allowed; it is empty because no tracked file matches (tests/unit/real-data-copy-rule-parity.test.ts checks that).
